name: mode-atlas
description: Mode Atlas static web app smoke tests

scripts.release:check: python3 build_revision_assets.py && python3 build_social_backend.py && python3 sync_ios_project.py && python3 validate_ios_firebase_config.py --require && python3 audit_project.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_web_publish.py' -v && python3 build_ios_web.py --check && node --test tests/backend.test.js tests/frontend.test.js tests/ios-foundation.test.js tests/ios-theme.test.js tests/study-flow.test.js tests/progression.test.js tests/social.test.js
scripts.ios:sync: python3 sync_ios_project.py && npm run build:ios-web && npx cap sync ios && python3 sync_ios_project.py --normalize-spm-links
scripts.test:polish: playwright test tests/polish.spec.js tests/ios-theme.spec.js tests/ios-home.spec.js tests/ios-experience.spec.js tests/study-flow.spec.js tests/trainer-modes.spec.js tests/progression.spec.js tests/dev-backups.spec.js tests/social.spec.js tests/account-navigation.spec.js tests/sounds.spec.js tests/release-readiness.spec.js
scripts.test:social: npm run build:social && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.social:install: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend/functions ci
scripts.social:status: backend/node_modules/.bin/firebase firestore:databases:get --project mode-atlus && backend/node_modules/.bin/firebase functions:list --project mode-atlus
